summary: Catalyst Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K announcing a definitive merger agreement with Angelini Pharma S.p.A., under which Angelini will acquire all outstanding shares for $31.50 per share in cash. The deal values Catalyst at approximately $2.4 billion equity, with the stock closing at $29.86 on May 6 representing an ~5.5% premium. The transaction was unanimously approved by Catalyst's board, which recommends stockholders vote in favor. Closing is expected in H2 2026, subject to regulatory approvals and stockholder vote. A 30-day go-shop period allows Catalyst to solicit superior proposals. Watch for competing bids during the go-shop.
